eventDescription:
In this programme, 250 native Tamil tree species?such as Azhinji, Purasa, Iluppai, Ilavam, Panjukottai, Kodaikappuli, Nettlingam, Thanri, Punnai, Kadambu, and Thethankottai?were planted, reflecting the rich natural heritage of our land.
At a time when the beauty of nature is steadily diminishing, it has become essential to instill environmental awareness in the minds of children and youth.
